races.paceDynamic: Hello Luna will be the primary pace-setter from stall position, with fellow prominent runners Honour Your Dreams, Secret Handsheikh, Under Curfew, Cameley Days, Barnsnape Boy and Tilsworth Ony Ta likely to track close behind in the opening stages. This creates a potentially strong pace scenario with multiple horses wanting to be handy early over the minimum trip. The hold-up horses Cabeza De Llave, Dragon God, Manhattan Chute and She Went Whoosh will need to rely on the pace being strong enough to set up their late kicks. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can secure good early positions without being trapped wide, as they can dictate terms and have tactical options in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Hello Luna goes off hard and the prominent runners engage early over this minimum trip
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable and creates perfect conditions for the hold-up horses to close strongly in the final furlong. The early pace-setters will tie up, allowing the closers to sweep past with their superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Controlled Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners settle into a manageable rhythm without going too fast early
scenarios.body: Hello Luna, Honour Your Dreams and Secret Handsheikh can sustain their efforts to the line with tactical speed reserves. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground against horses who haven't emptied the tank early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Scrimmaging Start
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners clash for position and cause interference or bunching in the early stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes stop-start which disrupts rhythm and favours horses with good acceleration from off the pace. Those caught up in early trouble will struggle to recover over the short distance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates Solo
scenarios.trigger: If Hello Luna gets an uncontested lead with the other prominent runners settling further back than expected
scenarios.body: Hello Luna can dictate fractions and kick clear when the pressure comes, as the others have left themselves too much to do. The lack of early pressure plays into the leader's hands perfectly.

races.paceDynamic: Jazl emerges as the sole front runner in this small field, having shown early pace in both career starts and likely to dictate terms from the gate. With Starryfield, Swiped, and Stolen all racing prominently behind, there's insufficient early speed to create pressure on the leader through the opening fractions. Miss Nightcap's style remains unknown but faces the challenge of spotting the field a head start in a short sprint. This tactical setup creates a sustainable pace scenario that strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions without expending energy in early battles.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Jazl Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Jazl breaks cleanly and settles into an uncontested lead.
scenarios.body: The Crisford runner dictates comfortable fractions before quickening in the final furlong, utilizing superior early speed to maximum advantage. His previous placings at this trip on similar ground suggest he can sustain the effort when not pressured early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Starryfield or Swiped press Jazl from the outset.
scenarios.body: The increased early tempo stretches the field and creates opportunities for horses that can quicken from close range. De Sousa's mount Starryfield showed improved form when racing more aggressively last time and could capitalize on tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Miss Nightcap Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the unknown quantity possesses superior finishing speed to overcome her positioning disadvantage.
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced newcomer benefits from the steady early pace to unleash untapped acceleration in the closing stages. Her higher official rating suggests latent ability that could be exposed under these conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stolen Finds Improvement
scenarios.trigger: If the Johnson Houghton runner builds on recent consistent efforts to find extra gear.
scenarios.body: The 5lb claimer's mount capitalizes on the steady pace and lighter weight to outfinish more fancied rivals. Her trainer's recent improvement in form provides additional confidence for a forward move.

races.paceDynamic: Dutch Kingdom will lead uncontested early as the sole confirmed front-runner, setting a sustainable gallop that won't blow the field apart. Five horses (Zarathos, The Hare Rail, Kodi Fire, Norflondonforever, Canopus) all want prominent positions behind Dutch Kingdom, creating inevitable traffic problems and interference 2-3 furlongs out as they jostle for racing room. The large hold-up contingent (Narmar, Great Blasket, Symphony Of Joy, Risen Again, Under The Sun, Crimson Road) will be relying on gaps appearing late. This race strongly favours front-runners and early prominent horses who can secure clear racing room before the cavalry charge arrives.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Dutch Kingdom gets soft fractions and kicks clear entering the straight
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader has too much left in the tank while the prominent brigade get tangled up behind him, allowing Dutch Kingdom to maintain his advantage to the line. The hold-up horses never get the strong pace they need to close effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the five prominent runners create a wall of horses that blocks the hold-up brigade
scenarios.body: Zarathos or Kodi Fire emerge from the scramble with clear racing room while stronger finishers like Narmar and Great Blasket get shut out by the traffic jam. The winner comes from those able to secure an unimpeded passage 2f out.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Dutch Kingdom goes too fast early or the prominent runners collapse from their tactical battle
scenarios.body: The strong pace and tactical meltdown up front sets up perfectly for a swooping finish from Narmar or Great Blasket who get the gaps they need. Under The Sun could also benefit from the race falling apart ahead of him.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Dutch Kingdom goes pedestrian and nobody wants to take it on
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 3f pole with no real pace to aim at, turning into a muddling affair where any horse with a turn of foot can win. This scenario heavily favours those with natural speed over stamina.

The apprentice claims for Jack Dace and Jude Fernandes could prove decisive in a tight finish where every pound matters

races.paceDynamic: Koko Blue will lead uncontested from the start, setting a sustainable pace without early pressure from the prominent runners Douglas Dc, Gearing's Point, and Belle Amie who are likely to sit just behind. The midfield will be relatively empty, creating a clear division between the early pace group and the large contingent of hold-up horses including Moon Over The Sea, Stintino Sunset, and Fullforward. With Koko Blue's tendency to fade late and no other natural leaders, this sets up a rhythm that allows closers to time their runs perfectly. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can capitalize on the steady early pace and pick off the fading leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Late
scenarios.trigger: If Koko Blue sets uncontested fractions and fades as expected in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets the perfect setup with sustainable early pace allowing them to unleash decisive late runs. Moon Over The Sea and Stintino Sunset benefit most from this patient tactical approach.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Belle Amie or Douglas Dc can secure ideal tracking positions and kick when Koko Blue weakens
scenarios.body: The prominently-raced horses avoid the risk of traffic problems that often hinder closers while getting first run on the tiring leader. Belle Amie's recent winning form makes her the most likely to capitalize from this tactical position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Surprises All
scenarios.trigger: If Koko Blue finds improved stamina reserves and the pace proves too steady for effective late challenges
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader gets such an easy time early that he retains enough energy to repel late challenges despite his usual fading tendencies. This scenario requires the closers to leave their runs too late on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Koko Blue stops badly and the prominent runners also weaken dramatically turning for home
scenarios.body: The entire pace setup disintegrates leaving a scramble where any horse with a bit of stamina left can capitalize regardless of running style. This chaos scenario often produces surprise winners from the back of the field.

races.paceDynamic: Read All About It and Hawaiian King are confirmed front-runners who will engage from the start, creating an honest gallop over this 1m2f trip. With only two true leaders in an 8-runner field, they'll set a solid tempo without going suicidal early. The prominent racers Beta Reader and Bizou will track just behind, while the four hold-up horses (Happy Chandler, Celebrating Ethel, Fighting Poet, Haveagobeau) will need the pace to soften late. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can sit close enough to the pace but avoid the early duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Beta Reader or Bizou can track the leaders without getting involved in their early battle
scenarios.body: They get the perfect trip sitting third or fourth, then pounce when the front two weaken in the final furlong. The hold-up horses have too much ground to make up with only two setting the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the two front-runners go too hard trying to establish dominance early
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final quarter-mile, allowing the closers to sweep up from the back. Happy Chandler's recent win and strong going record makes him the prime beneficiary.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Hawaiian King or Read All About It can steal a march while the other front-runner falters
scenarios.body: The survivor gets an uncontested lead in the final half-mile and holds on gamely. The lack of early pace pressure allows them to dictate terms completely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners compromise each other with a sustained early battle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the back straight with all the hold-up horses in with chances. Fighting Poet's class and Haveagobeau's recent form could shine through.

races.paceDynamic: Midnight Call emerges as the sole committed early leader, with Candy Warhol and Dreambird Dolly showing prominent tendencies but neither guaranteed to press. This creates a potentially uncontested lead scenario for Midnight Call, who can dictate fractions without pressure through the early stages. The majority field comprises hold-up horses including Phoenix Moon, Dark Sun, Twirler, and My Mate Kev, setting up a classic front-runner versus closers dynamic. This race shape strongly favours the front-runner Midnight Call, as sustainable early fractions will make it difficult for the large pack of hold-up horses to generate enough late momentum over 6f.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Midnight Call gets an easy lead with minimal early pressure
scenarios.body: Midnight Call can control the tempo and kick clear in the final furlong, while the large pack of hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back. The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to save enough energy for a strong finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Candy Warhol or Dreambird Dolly press Midnight Call early
scenarios.body: The increased early tempo softens up the front-runners and sets up perfect conditions for the closers to strike late. Hold-up horses like Phoenix Moon and Dark Sun benefit from the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders fold completely entering the final 2f
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between the hold-up horses, with those showing recent good form and strong finishing kicks coming to the fore. This scenario particularly suits horses with proven finishing speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Candy Warhol tracks the pace perfectly and times his run
scenarios.body: The 7-year-old's recent 5f form translates well to this tactical scenario, sitting off Midnight Call before striking late. His prominent style allows him to avoid traffic while staying close enough to pounce.
